summary: DATA-MODEL-1 v1 foundation milestone verified end-to-end on the shared backend. All 9 pytest tests pass (test_data_model_1_iter269.py): migration correctness across all 38 households, idempotency of backfill_data_model (0 new records on second run), verify_invariants python API + CLI script both green (violations=0), seeded legacy caregiver migration mapping (family_member -> caregiver + link, requires_relationship_update=True, owner not duplicated, idempotent, cleanup verified), and additive change regressions: cathy login / /api/auth/me / /api/household/members v3 shape / /api/participant/today all still return 200 with expected fields.
critical_code_review_comments: data_model.py verify_invariants iterates households once but issues N+ per-household queries (count/find in a loop) — acceptable at 38 households, but should be batched via aggregate($group) if households scale to thousands.

backfill_data_model uses `bereavement_grace_expires_at not in h` to decide whether to $set the null default. That works only when h is the raw doc. It's currently correct because the projection is {'_id':0} (no field-list restriction), so absent field means truly absent. If the projection is ever narrowed the default-init check would silently break — worth a comment.

In backfill_data_model, participant record lookup uses `{household_id, archived_at:None, deceased_at:None}` without filtering by user_id. If a managed-only (user_id=None) live record already exists, the owner-self participant record won't be created — future PARTICIPANTS-1 rewire should double-check this shortcut still holds for existing households.
seed_data_creation: Test seeds one legacy db.household_members active row (TEST_iter269_* uid) on cathy's household to prove caregiver migration mapping; deleted (with its created membership + link) in the same test's finally block. Verified no residuals — final invariants check inside the test passes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DATA-MODEL-1 backfill is confirmed idempotent and invariants green over 38 households. Startup log line format: `DATA-MODEL-1 backfill={...} invariants_ok=True violations=0`. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_data_model_1_iter269.py is safe to re-run any time; it seeds+cleans its own caregiver fixture. When PARTICIPANTS-1 rewires reads to participant_records, extend this file with additional invariant-diff checks. Note: /api/household/members v3 fields live under body.capacity, NOT at top level.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found in DATA-MODEL-1. One initial test assertion mismatch (expected v3 keys at top level of /api/household/members instead of under `capacity`) was a test-authoring bug on my side; corrected in-place and re-run green.
